The `blowhorn analytics` commands. Each one's `--help` prints the same text.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`analytics history`](#blowhorn-analytics-history) | Print the follower history the collectors have already recorded, as one dated series read from the store: every LinkedIn page and every profile's X trend, whichever machine collected them. |
| [`analytics operations`](#blowhorn-analytics-operations) | Aggregate the run ledger, read from the store, into operations per profile, per platform, per command, per day or per host. |

## blowhorn analytics history

Print the follower history the collectors have already recorded, as one dated series read from the store: every LinkedIn page and every profile's X trend, whichever machine collected them. Tolerates the N/A cells the collectors write, and derives the 30-day net, growth rate and (LinkedIn pages only) unfollowed figures, each labelled derived in the output; X profiles carry a net change and no unfollowed count, because X measures only the total. A store that cannot be reached exits 3.

```text
blowhorn analytics history [OPTIONS]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--since` | string |  | How far back to read: a number with d, w, m or y (30d, 12m, 1y), or 'all' (default: 12m) |
| `--subject` | string |  | One page or profile name (all by default) |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` | Emit machine-readable JSON output |
| `--platform` | string |  | Platform scope for 'blowhorn analytics'. One of: bluesky, linkedin, x, all ('all' means every platform listed here) |
| `--pace` | string |  | Accepted by 'blowhorn analytics history' because --pace is a global flag, but this command does no paced work -- it opens no browser and sleeps between nothing -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs and appears only in the Pace column of the -v summary. Resolved as CLI flag, then BLOWHORN_PACE, then defaults.pace in .blowhorn.yaml (normal when none is set); an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |

Also takes the [shared flags](/docs/reference/cli/shared-flags/): `--config`, `--log-dir`, `--profile`, `--exclude`, `--headless`, `--chrome-launch`, `--headed`, `--dry-run`, `--verbose`.

Examples:

```bash
blowhorn analytics history --json --since 12m
blowhorn analytics history --json --subject Layer5 --since all
blowhorn analytics history --subject lee --since 90d
```

Output: json with --json, text otherwise.

## blowhorn analytics operations

Aggregate the run ledger, read from the store, into operations per profile, per platform, per command, per day or per host: how many runs each action made, what they confirmed, skipped and failed, and which profiles and platforms were active. Reads the ledger only - a dry run is counted apart and never as an operation, and records exist from the first run after this command shipped, so a window older than that reports zero rather than guessing. Per host is the per-machine history now that several machines share one store. A store that cannot be reached exits 3.

```text
blowhorn analytics operations [OPTIONS]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--since` | string |  | How far back to read: a number with d, w, m or y (30d, 12m, 1y), or 'all' (default: 30d) |
| `--group-by` | string |  | Aggregate per profile, platform, command, day or host -- host is the machine that ran it (default: profile) |
| `--kind` | string |  | Which ledger records to aggregate: run (action runs, the default) or tick (scheduler passes) |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` | Emit machine-readable JSON output |
| `--platform` | string |  | Platform scope for 'blowhorn analytics'. One of: bluesky, linkedin, x, all ('all' means every platform listed here) |
| `--pace` | string |  | Accepted by 'blowhorn analytics operations' because --pace is a global flag, but this command does no paced work -- it opens no browser and sleeps between nothing -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs and appears only in the Pace column of the -v summary. Resolved as CLI flag, then BLOWHORN_PACE, then defaults.pace in .blowhorn.yaml (normal when none is set); an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |

Also takes the [shared flags](/docs/reference/cli/shared-flags/): `--config`, `--log-dir`, `--profile`, `--exclude`, `--headless`, `--chrome-launch`, `--headed`, `--dry-run`, `--verbose`.

Examples:

```bash
blowhorn analytics operations --json --since 30d --group-by profile
blowhorn analytics operations --json --since 7d --group-by platform
blowhorn analytics operations --kind tick --group-by day --since 14d
blowhorn analytics operations --group-by host --since 30d
```

Output: json with --json, text otherwise.
